name: Universal TV Safe Zone Padding
description: Adds overscan-safe padding around page edges so content is not cut off on TV

params.css: body { padding: 24px 48px !important; box-sizing: border-box !important; } header, nav, [role='banner'] { margin-left: 24px !important; margin-right: 24px !important; } footer, [role='contentinfo'] { margin-left: 24px !important; margin-right: 24px !important; margin-bottom: 24px !important; } main, [role='main'], article { margin-left: auto !important; margin-right: auto !important; max-width: calc(100% - 96px) !important; }
